lines.zh: 我踩着海边的沙，走得很随意。
lines.en: I walk the beach sand at an easy pace.

lines.zh: 这副样子，是作者自己的皮肤。
lines.en: This look is the author's own skin.

lines.zh: 我走起来和别的海嗣不一样。
lines.en: I do not walk like the other seaborn.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，慢慢晃。
lines.en: I stroll along with my hands behind my back.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块礁石，又绕回来。
lines.en: I go around a rock, then come back.

lines.zh: 潮水追着我，我走得比它快。
lines.en: The tide chases me and I outpace it.

lines.zh: 我走了几步，回头看有没有人。
lines.en: I take a few steps and look back.
I stamp through the puddles, smack smack.
I pace up and down the shoreline.

lines.zh: 我不像来打仗的，更像来散步。
lines.en: I look less like a fighter than a walker.
My step is a little flippant.
I saunter in your direction.

lines.zh: 我把脚抬得很高，又轻轻放下。
lines.en: I lift a foot high and set it down gently.
I sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子散步。
lines.en: I stroll along, stepping on my own shadow.
This getup of mine is not often seen.
I stand with my hands on my hips.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，好像在想事。
lines.en: I look at the sky as if thinking.
I lean on a rock and stare at nothing.
I turn a full circle on the spot.

lines.zh: 这副皮肤，只有作弊才见得到。
lines.en: This skin only shows up through cheats.
I adjust my hem.

lines.zh: 我不急，我本来就不该在这。
lines.en: No hurry; I am not even supposed to be here.

lines.zh: 我对着海面理了理头发。
lines.en: I tidy my hair, watching my reflection.

lines.zh: 我摆弄着手指打发时间。
lines.en: I fiddle with my fingers to pass the time.

lines.zh: 我在等一个认得我的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who recognizes me.

lines.zh: 海浪拍上来，我退了半步。
lines.en: A wave comes in and I step back.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看不出在想什么。
lines.en: My head tilts; no telling what I think.
My shadow looks a bit silly.
I glance at the sea again.
I do not stand much like a seaborn.
I raise a hand and measure something.
Do you recognize me?
I did not spawn normally.
You used cheats, did you not.
I wink at you.
Do not point a spawn egg at me.
There is something familiar between us.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我这样子很好笑吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is this look funny?

lines.zh: 我这张脸，作者画了很久。
lines.en: The author took a long time on this face.

lines.zh: 我这张脸只是来露一面。
lines.en: This face of mine is only here for a cameo.
Put down what is in your hand.
I know this world.

lines.zh: 我们见过的，在别的存档里。
lines.en: We have met before, in another save.
Ouch, you actually hit me.
I stagger back two steps.

lines.zh: 这对我一个彩蛋来说太重了。
lines.en: That is too much for an easter egg.
I cover my face.
My clothes are torn; now I look bad.
I rub my arm and hiss through my teeth.
You hit hard.
I clutch my ribs; I've stopped laughing.
I will remember that.
I am not very tough.
You are offering me food?
I am not picky; anything works.

lines.zh: 这东西是你刷出来的吧。
lines.en: You spawned this, did you not.
I sniff it; it beats the sea wind.
I only eat what friends offer.

lines.zh: 你把东西举稳，我这副样子很挑。
lines.en: Hold it steady; this body of mine is picky.
I could eat it, or not.
I reach out and take it.
You taste it first.
This will not break the balance, will it?
I don't even chew; I just swallow.
Any more?
I am not hungry; I just want the taste.
Keep it; I will just look.
Will I vanish once I finish?

lines.zh: 这味道，我在别的游戏里尝过。
lines.en: I have tasted this in another game.
Hey, give me some room.
Why did you bump me.
I nearly fell into the water.

lines.zh: 我踉跄一下，还笑得出来。
lines.en: I stumble, but I'm still smiling.

lines.zh: 我退半步，做个请的手势。
lines.en: I step back and gesture for you to go on.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住了我的衣摆。
lines.en: Your boot is pinning the hem of my coat.
I hold my ground and you give way.
Water splashes up from the ground.
That was a solid bump.
We look like we are doing a clumsy dance.
That would not be appropriate.
I am only an easter egg.
The author did not give me that.
I will just stand here.

lines.zh: 我摸摸后颈，避开这个话题。
lines.en: I rub the back of my neck and dodge the subject.
Let us not talk about it.
I turn to look at the sea.

lines.zh: 同一个模组里，还有别的皮肤。
lines.en: There are other skins in this mod.
I smile, awkwardly.
The tide is far more reliable.

lines.zh: 我捡起来擦了擦给你看。
lines.en: I pick it up, wipe it, and show you.
I picked it up for you. Don't thank me.
I turn it over in my hand.
Nice; I am keeping it.

lines.zh: 这东西在彩蛋身上没用。
lines.en: This is useless on an easter egg.
I pocket it.
I look, then hand it back.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，不捡白不捡。
lines.en: Free things on the ground; why not.

lines.zh: 我举起来，看它透不透光。
lines.en: I hold it up to see if light passes through.
Could this be spawned too?
Oh, we are fighting?
I have not trained for this.
I strike a pose.

lines.zh: 这个姿势是不是太敷衍了。
lines.en: Is this stance too half-hearted?

lines.zh: 我摆了个架势，不太标准。
lines.en: I strike a pose. It's not a good one.
Not the face.
I raise a hand to my chest.
Are you sure you want to hit an easter egg?
I am ready. Probably.
Fine, I'll trade a few swings with you.
Do not chase me.
I run in circles.
I hide behind a rock.
This is hardly fair.
I am not a fast runner.
My clothes are snagged.
I look back as I run.
Is this what they call bullying an easter egg?
I can keep running a while.
Are you tired yet?
I give you a careless swat.
That punch was not very professional.
I missed.
I hit, but it was light.
I swing my arm and pretend I know how.
If you laugh, I stop.
I charge and stumble first.
That one does not count.
I step back and reset my pose.
Do not laugh.

lines.zh: 我出现在这，多半是有人作弊。
lines.en: I am here because someone cheated.

lines.zh: 这是作者的脸，借你一看。
lines.en: This is the author's face, on loan.
An easter egg creature, just this one.
I came out of a spawn egg.
Do not take this seriously.
I settle and look around.

lines.zh: 这一身装扮，平时见不到。
lines.en: This outfit is rarely seen.
I scratch my head.

lines.zh: 水边多了个奇怪的身影。
lines.en: A strange figure appears by the water.
I wave at you.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的衣角，我赶紧拍。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔得很狼狈。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land in a heap.

lines.zh: 我不会水，我可不想淹死。
lines.en: I cannot swim, and I do not want to drown.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over twice.
There's a new arrow hole in my clothes.

lines.zh: 一阵光打过来，我眼冒金星。
lines.en: A flash of magic hits and I see stars.

lines.zh: 饿得我都没力气摆样子了。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me no strength to pose.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我头发都直了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞了，彩蛋也没了。
lines.en: The void swallows me, easter egg and all.
